## Interpretation

"Clean up the implementation" was ambiguous. The module is a 7-line Go program that was already correct, gofmt clean, vetted and passing. Applying the attached conventions left no real defects, so I kept the change surgical and behavior-preserving rather than speculating a redesign (R007: simplicity, surgical changes, verifiable success).

## Changes

- `main.go`: added a short doc comment for `add`. Logic unchanged.
- `main_test.go`: refactored the single assertion into a table-driven test that computes the result once instead of calling `add` twice, and covers positive, negative and zero inputs.

No rules from `prompt.md` applied to file layout, dependencies or errors here, so I did not add directories, dependencies or error types (R006, R008 were not relevant to this Go code). No existing comments or user edits were removed (R037, R040), and no typographic dash was introduced (R024).
